description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for interacting with CloudZero settings via REST API calls, including fetching, updating, and deleting settings, along with associated hooks for use in React components.

methods.name: getCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Fetches CloudZero settings from the server using GET request.

methods.name: updateCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Updates CloudZero settings via PUT request with provided parameters.

methods.name: deleteCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Deletes CloudZero settings on the server via DELETE request.
